capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Enel is the former tyrannical "God" of Skypiea who established a theocracy around himself. Once an inhabitant of Birka, Enel destroyed his homeland through the powers of the Goro Goro no Mi and led a small army of loyalists to take over Skypiea. As the nation's new "God," he ruthlessly exploited its populace and resources to build a massive airship aimed toward "Fairy Vearth"—the moon. [Chapter 279] Though defeated by Monkey D.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Enel is the former tyrannical "God" of Skypiea who established a theocracy around himself. As the nation's new "God," he ruthlessly exploited its populace and resources to build a massive airship aimed toward "Fairy Vearth"—the moon. [Chapter 279] Though defeated by Monkey D.
capability_summary.offense: Enel ate the Goro Goro no Mi, a Logia-type [Chapter 272] Devil Fruit that allows him to create, control, and transform his body into lightning. He can use a variety of lightning-based attacks, either by channeling lightning through his body or by striking the drums on his back. Its power is said to be invincible. [Chapter 274] Enel is able to attack his opponents with close-ranged electrocution by touching them [Chapter 259] or by unleashing long-ranged bolts or blasts of lightning to attack from afar; [Chapter 241] he can also shape his lightning into animal creatures. [Chapter 276] [Chapter 276] [Chapter 279] Generally, Enel can freely control the power output he unleashes, up to a maximum of 200,000,000 volts. [Chapter 280] When amplified by his ship, his powers became strong enough to easily destroy an entire island. [Chapter 294]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Enel has melee combat skills even without relying on his Devil Fruit powers. He has adequate acrobatic skills, which he uses to dodge attacks such as the shots of Wyper's bazooka and Zoro's sword attacks. He possesses incredible physical strength.

He is also very perceptive and has an amazing deductive ability, quickly seeing through Robin's deception and concluding that the Shandorian Golden Belfry Bell was not at Upper Yard but beyond it.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Haki
demonstrated_abilities.description: Enel is an extremely skilled user of Observation Haki, known as "Mantra" in the sky islands. His Haki is further enhanced by his Devil Fruit powers, making him virtually omniscient of the thoughts and actions of Skypiea. [Chapter 278] With enough skill, he can use this Haki to predict an opponent's moves shortly before they make them, thereby making the attack that much easier to evade. This prediction appears to the user as an image or brief "premonition" of what the opponent will do in the user's mind-eye, and the damage the user will take if the attack actually "hits".

He can transform any body parts of his choosing into blades, allowing him to perfectly combine blade work with martial arts skills, literally making him a living weapon; he can turn his arms into blades to augment his hand chops, turn his legs into blades to augment his kicks, turn his fingers into blades to make them like razor sharp claws, and even turn the bottoms of his feet into blades so that he can glide across the ground as if he were ice skating. capability_summary.offense: Arlong's nose is over a foot long, lined with razor-sharp edges, and more than sturdy enough to use as a melee weapon. He is very proud of his nose, which he claims is unbreakable. demonstrated_abilities.name: Nose
demonstrated_abilities.description: Arlong's nose is over a foot long, lined with razor-sharp edges, and more than sturdy enough to use as a melee weapon. By swinging his head back and forth, Arlong defeated Zoro (who was weakened by the wound given to him by Mihawk and his fight with Hatchan) in a sword fight. He is very proud of his nose, which he claims is unbreakable. [Chapter 89] His nose's durability is particularly evident by the fact that he flew directly into the concrete of Arlong Park without damaging it, causing others to look on in shock and comment on its toughness.

[Chapter 90] Luffy demonstrated, however, that these teeth can also be used against Arlong, either by holding them in his hands or fitting them in his mouth and biting his opponent with them. However, Arlong states that only a fish-man can fully utilize the strength of the teeth as he possesses stronger jaw muscles than a human.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Don Krieg is the admiral of the Krieg Pirates, widely reputed as Foul-Play Krieg for his underhanded methods. At his height, he was also known as the Pirate Fleet Admiral, commanding a fleet of fifty ships (totaling some 5,000 pirates) throughout the East Blue. After effectively dominating East Blue piracy, Krieg attempted to conquer the Grand Line, only to have his fleet decimated by Dracule Mihawk of the Seven Warlords of the Sea.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Don Krieg is the admiral of the Krieg Pirates, widely reputed as Foul-Play Krieg for his underhanded methods. At his height, he was also known as the Pirate Fleet Admiral, commanding a fleet of fifty ships (totaling some 5,000 pirates) throughout the East Blue. After effectively dominating East Blue piracy, Krieg attempted to conquer the Grand Line, only to have his fleet decimated by Dracule Mihawk of the Seven Warlords of the Sea.
capability_summary.offense: The Daisenso is Krieg's ultimate melee weapon, formed by locking his shoulder-plates against one another and activating internal devices that produce a shaft and a blade from between. [Chapter 64] In addition to its long reach, the spear's head explodes on impact with any solid surface, with heavier impacts producing proportionally larger explosions; thus, even glancing hits or near-misses can wreak severe damage. To compensate for the blade's relative fragility, the explosive mechanism is stored primarily in the plates, allowing the spear to keep exploding even if the blade is completely destroyed. [Chapter 65]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Krieg also claimed to be the strongest man in the world, and while this is clearly a vast overestimation on his part, he is certainly formidable in physical combat, possessing massive physical strength. He could break Gin's arm with his grip, defend against cannonballs using his hand without moving an inch, and easily lift and throw the Sabagashira I a far distance into the Baratie restaurant with a single hand. He can also lift the one-ton Great Battle Spear single-handedly and swing it around freely while wearing his golden wootz armor.

capability_summary.tactics: Krieg is also a sound tactician and expert strategist, realizing the material value of his subordinates and requiring them to be at perfect health, as well as using decoys and disguises to avoid unnecessary battles (such as disguising his flagship as a Marine vessel to enter village harbors easily, or dressing up his first-mate as himself to distract pursuers). His dishonest and unethical behavior, despite showing his lack of honesty, is a testament of his strategic aptitude. His plan to steal Baratie as a suitable replacement for his damaged ship due to its ridiculous and non-threatening appearance would prove crucial for his future pirate ambitions.

demonstrated_abilities.name: MH5
demonstrated_abilities.description: The is Krieg's most dreaded weapon: an explosive shell containing a highly potent chemical toxin. Typically fired from the central launcher in Krieg's left shoulder-plate, its impact spreads a large cloud of gas that lasts around five minutes. [Chapter 62] The poison inflicts immediate organ failure and internal bleeding if breathed unprotected and, according to Krieg, kills within an hour. As a precaution for its use, Krieg and his crewmen all carry gas masks.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Other Weapons
demonstrated_abilities.description: Krieg carries at least two double-barreled pistols on his person. Used in conjunction with his armor's gun array, these bring his maximum rate of fire to fourteen rounds per second. During the first part of his battle against Luffy, he wielded a huge spiked flail on a chain, apparently unconnected to any part of his armor. [Chapter 54] While reasonably effective, Krieg apparently abandoned it after Luffy deflected it, temporarily knocking out Pearl.

demonstrated_abilities.description: For unknown reasons, the anime does not depict Krieg's shuriken bomb, making his threat to deploy the MH5 a serious one from the start. In the live-action series, Krieg does not survive his battle with Dracule Mihawk and so does not show up at the Baratie.

capability_summary.offense: The Nukiashi is Kuro's signature technique, a maneuver combining speed and stealth for nigh-undetectable movement. Using it, Kuro easily outmaneuvered a combined attack from Sham and Buchi—and, according to Jango, could ambush and kill fifty skilled assassins without being noticed. This is called Pussyfoot Maneuver in the VIZ manga and Funimation adaptations and Stealth Walk in the 4Kids dub.
capability_summary.defense_durability: Despite his slim build, Kuro's physical prowess is considerable, well above the average East Blue pirate (and carefully maintained, even during his years of civilian life). Speed is his primary asset, with his legs being powerful enough to cross 100 meters in four to five seconds (a speed of 20–25 m/s, or 72–90 km/h). Per his standard fighting style, his arms and hands are also strong - and dexterous - enough to wield ten full-sized blades simultaneously.

capability_summary.offense: Foxy ate the Noro Noro no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows him to emit special unique microscopic photon particles as beams of light. Anything hit by these photons, both living and non-living things, will be trapped in a state of slow motion for 30 seconds (he demonstrates this by slowing down a cannon ball fired at him, only to get hit by the cannonball anyway when he was gloating over his power for too long). Even Foxy himself is not immune to his own power.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Caesar Clown, who was referred to as "Master" by his subordinates, is a scientist, the leading expert on chemical weapons of mass destruction, and one of the co-founders of NEO MADS. Caesar is a former colleague of Vegapunk, having worked with him both in MADS and later the World Government research facility on Punk Hazard, an island that Caesar went on to devastate with a toxic gas explosion, [Chapter 684] earning him a bounty of 300,000,000. Years later, Caesar returned to the island in secret to continue his illegal experiments until his defeat at the hands of the Straw Hat Pirates and Trafalgar Law. [Chapter 697] One of his projects was the production of SAD, a chemical that he supplied to the Warlord Donquixote Doflamingo to be used in the manufacturing of SMILEs, artificial Devil Fruits which were sold to the Emperor Kaidou to help create an army of Zoans. [Chapter 689]

weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: Vergo's main weapon was a long bamboo stick, which was most likely the source of his epithet, "Demon Bamboo", and he frequently used it in tandem with his Armament Haki. [Chapter 672] It also doubled as a blowgun, which could shoot bamboo arrows (bullets in the anime) that created large explosions. When Vergo used this attack, the stick became enlarged, but it did not break. In the anime, this technique was depicted with the bamboo making a horn-like sound.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Ordeal of Balls — Techniques
demonstrated_abilities.description: *Bikkuri Tamatsuki: Satori launches a surprise cloud into another surprise cloud, calculating their ricochet trajectories (a la billiards and other cue sports) so they will reach a faraway opponent. As Satori has advanced knowledge of all the clouds' positions, he can use this technique to feint an attack toward one opponent while actually aiming for another. In the VIZ manga, this is called Suprise Balls and Surprise Cloud Billiards in the Funimation adaptations. *Bikkuri Tamakazura: Tama Dragon: Satori's ultimate attack, connecting many surprise clouds filled with incendiaries, gunpowder, and many bladed weapons in a serpentine shape, with a dragon mask strapped atop the "head" cloud.

He appears to use these against the Straw Hats multiple times without intercepting any attacks beforehand, suggesting he may be carrying several pre-charged Dials.

weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: Ohm's main weapon is the Eisen Whip, a sword whose blade is Iron Cloud generated by an Eisen Dial at the hilt. In addition to taking the form of a typical sword blade, Ohm can freely manipulate the cloud's shape and increase its length and width as he pleases. This, coupled with his advanced Mantra, gives him the ability to strike opponents a great distance away from him, and since the cloud can change shape almost instantaneously and he can foresee his opponents' next moves, he can strike opponents so quickly that very few can dodge him.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Kurozumi Kanjuro, nicknamed "Evening Shower" Kanjuro, was a samurai from the Kuri region of Wano Country and a member of the Kurozumi Family. After losing his parents, he was instructed by Kurozumi Orochi to operate undercover within the Kouzuki Family. Kanjuro became Kouzuki Oden's retainer and one of the Nine Red Scabbards while secretly aiding Orochi in his rise to power and efforts to eliminate the Kouzuki bloodline, by feeding him information.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Kurozumi Kanjuro, nicknamed "Evening Shower" Kanjuro, was a samurai from the Kuri region of Wano Country and a member of the Kurozumi Family. After losing his parents, he was instructed by Kurozumi Orochi to operate undercover within the Kouzuki Family. Kanjuro became Kouzuki Oden's retainer and one of the Nine Red Scabbards while secretly aiding Orochi in his rise to power and efforts to eliminate the Kouzuki bloodline, by feeding him information.
capability_summary.offense: Kanjuro ate the Fude Fude no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allowed him to generate ink that he can use to draw pictures and manifest and control anything he drew. His three-dimensional drawings had the same abilities as the things they are depicting; a drawing of a bird is able to fly, and a drawing of food is edible (although, according to Kin'emon, it hurts his stomach). He could create ink from his long hair and draw with it, or channel his power through his giant ink brush.
capability_summary.defense_durability: Kanjuro could use Armament Haki, known in Wano as "Ryuo", which he used to reinforce his ink brush to help Zoro and Kin'emon push back the Birdcage. Kanjuro's Armament Haki was strong enough to defend against the Birdcage's razor sharp threads that can easily slice cannon balls, meteorites, and large buildings. [Chapter 788]
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Kanjuro had immense strength, able to easily carry around and use his giant ink brush without tiring, and could equally clash with Kawamatsu, a fish-man with ten times the physical strength of an average human. By imbuing his brush with Armament Haki, Kanjuro was able to help push back and significantly slow down the contraction speed of Doflamingo's Torikago, along with many other powerful combatants. During his journey through Onigashima, he took down several members of the Beasts Pirates with no effort.

He has also fought with the Mink Tribe, including its two rulers, Inuarashi and Nekomamushi, for five days and five nights without rest. Despite this, he had to use a chemical weapon to finally defeat them all. [Chapter 810] Jack was shown to possess tremendous durability, having survived being hit by Zunesha's trunk and only briefly losing consciousness despite the force being enough to demolish his entire fleet. [Chapter 824] During the war on Onigashima, Jack was heavily injured by the Mink Tribe's forces, which had activated Sulong, but in the span of an hour, he managed to recover enough to go and attack the wounded Nine Red Scabbards, believing he had a better chance of killing them than even a fully healthy Tobiroppo like Black Maria. [Chapter 1005]

demonstrated_abilities.name: Swordsmanship
demonstrated_abilities.description: Jack is highly proficient in dual wielding his Shotel blades, able to fight equally with Nekomamushi and Inuarashi, the two strongest minks in the Mokomo Dukedom, in one-on-one combat. He was also capable of fighting evenly against the renowned thief Shutenmaru, whom even Kaidou had taken an interest in, and managed to injure Shutenmaru before their fight was cut short. Notably, even though Shutenmaru had managed to cut off most of the blade on one of his shotels, Jack was still able to fight competently with the short remainder of its blade.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Vinsmoke Judge, also known as Garuda, is the king of the Germa Kingdom, the supreme commander of the Germa 66, and the patriarch of the Vinsmoke Family, being Sanji's biological father. [Chapter 815] Judge is also a skilled scientist specialized in engineering and genetics, being responsible for the creation of most of Germa 66' technological advancements, including modifying his own children into super soldiers and developing the Raid Suit that supports their enhanced abilities. He is a former member of MADS, where he was a research partner to the leading World Government scientist Vegapunk and helped in co-discovering the existence of the Lineage Factor, which years later, led to him building and expanding his Kingdom's military might through the use of Cloning. After escaping Totto Land, Judge and Caesar Clown, his former colleague, created NEO MADS as a successor to MADS.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Shiki the Golden Lion, also known as the "Flying Pirate", is the admiral and helmsman of the Golden Lion Pirates. He is also a former member of the Rocks Pirates and the first known prisoner to have ever escaped from Impel Down. Shiki wreaked havoc on the seas during Roger's time, having commanded the largest pirate fleet of that period.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Shiki the Golden Lion, also known as the "Flying Pirate", is the admiral and helmsman of the Golden Lion Pirates. capability_summary.offense: Shiki possesses tremendous skills in swordsmanship, as he dual-wielded Oto and Kogarashi to single-handedly massacre an entire army of Marines before getting subdued by Garp and Sengoku. After the two swords had become his prosthetic legs, not only did he have little difficulty in standing or walking while using them, but he was also capable of attacking from a distance with them by sending slashes from his sword legs in a Rankyaku-like fashion. These air blades have a light-yellow/gold color scheme, matching his epithet.
capability_summary.defense_durability: Alongside Roger and Whitebeard, Shiki is one of the most powerful pirates of his generation. He had tremendous physical strength supplemented with his supreme sword skills, allowing him to slay an army of Marines alone at Marineford and fight both Garp and Sengoku. After capture, he was imprisoned in Level 6 of Impel Down and survived in prison despite his injuries from the previous battle.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Dr. Vegapunk was the leading scientist of the SSG in the employment of the Marines. His work included discovering the secrets and uses of seastone, the secrets of how Devil Fruit powers work, the co-discovery of the Lineage Factor and its applications, the creation of the Pacifista and Seraphim, and various other scientific achievements that are said to be at least 500 years ahead of current technology. [Chapter 433] [Chapter 485] He hailed from the technologically advanced Karakuri Island and resided on Egghead, where his laboratory is located.

capability_summary.offense: Vegapunk ate the Nomi Nomi no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allowed his brain to store an indefinite amount of information and eidetically recall everything he has ever learned. While Vegapunk was already a natural genius to begin with, this power greatly enhanced his mental efficiency and aptitude for learning and research. As a result, he reached a point where his scientific genius was completely unparalleled and he was able to make many futuristic breakthroughs in science and technology.

capability_summary.tactics: Befitting his high level of intelligence, Vegapunk possessed a great deal of tactical wit; it has been noted that the only one capable of duping Vegapunk is himself. He possessed excellent awareness of his laboratories and their functions, and so even his own satellite York could not hide her treachery for long as Vegapunk utilized his monitoring and surveillance systems to detect irregular activity, deducing in only a week that she was responsible for the theft of the Mother Flame. [Chapter 1123] Although Jaygarcia Saturn kept a close watch on the Pacifista project and asserted that Vegapunk would never be able to fool him, Vegapunk did manage to subvert his orders on two occasions which Saturn never discovered until the Egghead Incident: these were altering Kuma's self-destruct switch so it would only put him in a vegetative state instead of making him explode, and making Jewelry…
